 Follow Mckenna Grace Is a Work of Art in Plunging ALmee High-Slit Dress at Premiere
 Shweta Chakrawarty Fri, November 13, 2026 at 8:11 AM UTC 2 min read Add Yahoo as a preferred source to see more of our stories on Google. Photo Credit: @mckennagraceful / Instagram McKenna Grace delivered a true fashion fairytale at "The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping" premiere in Mexico City. The 20-year-old actor and singer stunned in an ALmée Couture creation from The Art of Remembering collection. Styled by Molly Dickson, Grace turned heads in the sculptural dress with a plunging neckline and high slit , blending fantasy-inspired craftsmanship with dramatic red carpet glamour.
 Mckenna Grace looks like a work of art in plunging ALmee dress with a thigh-high slit at 'Hunger Games' premiere
 McKenna Grace wore a shimmering champagne-toned gown featuring a daring plunging neckline that instantly stole the spotlight. Moreover, intricate crystal embellishments covered the fitted silhouette, giving the dress a radiant glow from every angle. The look also featured sculpted bird-inspired ornaments perched on both shoulders, creating an ethereal finish. Inspired by the mythical Cambodian Keno bird, the design came from ALmée Couture's Look 23, " Aetherial Majesty ," unveiled during Paris Fashion Week.
 However, the standout detail was the dramatic sculptural King Protea bloom placed at the hips. Layers of blush pink and iridescent blue petals flowed into an asymmetrical silhouette before extending into a sweeping champagne train. In addition, a thigh-high slit added movement while showing off her toned legs. The gown's lace-up back proved just as striking, highlighting the couture craftsmanship from every angle.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Grace completed the look with metallic gold platform heels featuring open toes. The shimmering footwear subtly complemented the crystal-covered gown without overpowering its intricate details.
 Meanwhile, her beauty look perfectly matched the fantasy-inspired ensemble. She styled her blonde hair in a sleek low bun with a deep side part, keeping every strand polished in place. Her makeup featured shimmering silver eyeshadow, fluttery lashes, softly defined brows, pink blush, and glossy pink lips. As a result, the luminous glam enhanced the gown's magical aesthetic.
 She finished the look with sparkling flower-shaped diamond stud earrings and long stiletto-shaped nude-beige nails featuring a sleek vertical black stripe. Overall, Grace looked every bit like a living work of art on the red carpet. In fact, she delivered one of the night's most unforgettable couture moments while celebrating "The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping" premiere.
